policy_floor: privacy_permissions routed-concern row, clause (2): an unreadable source must never read as OK / no grants (candidate floor; fixed, so not carried)
trigger: a key created with NtCreateKey in the profile owner's own hive (no admin) with an embedded NUL in its name
classification_rationale: an unreadable app key was reported as nothing (or a prefix sibling / the parent was read) while routed clause (2) says an unreadable source never reads as no grants
summary: counted subkey names with an embedded NUL were reopened by c_str() (open and from_wide stop at the NUL): the app was silently dropped, a prefix sibling read, or a leading NUL reopened the parent and emitted a spurious empty-app row. Also reported by cpp-safety (CS-1, INFO) and unhappy-path (UP-5). fixed in fbcd87d1e: enumerate_subkey_names skips and counts such names, win::enum_failure emits <kind>:name_embedded_nul; rig 6/7 NtCreateKey probe confirmed

severity_native: CRITICAL (speculative at raise; verified by rig probe)
trigger: a profile owner plants a symlink/dangling symlink/hardlink as NTUSER.DAT.LOG1 next to their unloaded hive; the SYSTEM agent loads it via RegLoadKeyW
classification_rationale: the guard checked NTUSER.DAT and its ancestors but not the sidecars the SYSTEM RegLoadKeyW opens/creates, while clause (6) presents the offline-arm guard as closing the offline-file hazard
summary: RegLoadKeyW run as SYSTEM follows planted sidecar links: rig session 6 showed a dangling NTUSER.DAT.LOG1 symlink makes the kernel CREATE its target during a read-only load (real plugin too) and a symlink/hardlink LOG1 is written through when the hive is written (forced-write control: victim 1040 B -> 33280 B); a directory junction is not followed; a 2 GiB sparse LOG1 has no effect on a read. fixed in 92a86852a: HiveFileGuard::read_sidecars refuses a reparse-point or hard-linked <leaf>* sidecar or more than 64 entries BEFORE the load (hive_sidecar_reparse / hive_sidecar_hardlinked / hive_sidecar_count); rig session 7 verified every planted shape refused with the victim untouched, the dangling target no longer created and a stock profile with real kernel sidecars accepted. Residual: a swap between the check and the load, as for the leaf; not tested: symlink creation by a standard user, a crafted hive forcing a write

trigger: the offline_hive_mutex wait behind a sibling plugin's offline arm or a stuck RegLoadKeyW overruns the 15 s deadline with no backstop
classification_rationale: README claimed the agent's own command bound is the backstop for the cooperative deadline; agent.cpp ~3831 target->execute() has no per-command bound (orchestrator-verified by grep)
summary: README caveat 4 clause deleted; fixed in fbcd87d1e

trigger: two agent-suite processes on the shared Windows pool run the offline-mount cases at once
classification_rationale: a fixed synthetic SID with a machine-wide HKEY_USERS substring scan (CLAUDE.md #1871 shared-identity invariant)
summary: kSyntheticSid was identical in every process and synthetic_mount_present() matched any HKU subkey for it; the after_load case had no Cleanup guard. Also build-ci B1 and consistency-auditor F2. fixed in fbcd87d1e: per-process salted SID, hoisted HiveCleanup used by the after_load case

trigger: NTUSER.DAT on a stalled SAN/VHDX/cloud-tiered volume
classification_rationale: classify_hive_file refused no FILE_ATTRIBUTE_OFFLINE/RECALL_ON_* hive although the attributes were already fetched
summary: a cloud/tiered placeholder NTUSER.DAT passed the guard and RegLoadKeyW recalled it while holding the process-wide offline_hive_mutex. fixed in fbcd87d1e: hive_not_resident (never SPARSE), rig-verified. The bounded lock wait is deferred (separate row)

trigger: a successfully read HKLM Deny for a key a reachable profile also holds with last-used times
classification_rationale: merge_with_hklm overwrote the whole RawGrant so the profile's LastUsedTime* (facts HKLM does not carry) were lost
summary: fixed in fbcd87d1e: the profile's last_used_start/stop are carried onto a successful HKLM Deny; pure test added

summary: ER-1..ER-4 plus cross-platform F1/F2 and compliance F1 (SOC2 :425/:542, privilege-model virtual-account and FSLogix/UPD/8.3 coverage gap): README, privilege model, SOC2 row and changelog updated; fixed in fbcd87d1e

waiver_rationale: pre-existing in untouched consumers; this PR ships the primitive that closes it for privacy_permissions and the follow-up adopts it elsewhere; surfaced to the operator for a private-advisory decision rather than left silent
trigger: a profile owner plants a sidecar link next to their NTUSER.DAT; any of the 5 unguarded consumers loads it as SYSTEM
classification_rationale: the same SYSTEM RegLoadKeyW sidecar link-following applies to the 5 other with_user_hive consumers (autoruns, registry, installed_apps, license_scan, tar), which keep today's unguarded behaviour by design (guard opt-in for privacy_permissions)
summary: pre-existing in code this change does not modify; the guard is built (HiveFileGuard) but opt-in. Follow-up: adopt it fleet-wide (move to agents/shared with an injected deadline callback). SECURITY: not to be filed as a public issue with exploit detail (Alex's rule: an exploitable vuln goes to GitHub private vulnerability reporting) — operator decision at the push gate; README caveat 4 and the changelog currently disclose the hazard in the repo

trigger: a transient holder (Search Indexer/AV/System Restore) makes the single unload fail; the mount and the NTUSER.DAT lock persist and the user's next sign-in may get a temporary profile
classification_rationale: ScopedUserHive makes one RegUnLoadKeyW call; no retry, no YUZU_HIVE_* sweep (also after an agent crash)
summary: deferred: bounded retry on unload + before-load sweep of stale YUZU_HIVE_<sid>_* under the mutex (or RegLoadAppKeyW on a copy as execution_artifacts does); also log the RegLoadKeyW rc (SRE-3). Shared seam for all consumers

trigger: NTUSER.DAT on a stalled volume while another plugin's offline arm waits
classification_rationale: ScopedOfflineHiveLock takes a plain lock_.lock(); a slow disk or recall under the lock blocks every other offline-arm plugin with no bound (also architect A-4)
summary: deferred: timed_mutex with a bounded wait (exported agents/core symbol) when the guard is adopted fleet-wide

adjudicated_by: Fable Architect (snr-dev governance r1 ruling H5/UP-3; same authoring session, independence asserted not enforced)
adjudication_rationale: replay at load is standard Windows recovery that would run at the user's next logon; no destruction or wrong result demonstrated; the side effect is disclosed
trigger: an unclean logoff/hybrid shutdown leaves a dirty hive that an offline dispatch loads
classification_rationale: RegLoadKeyW loads read-write: a dirty hive's NTUSER.DAT.LOG1/LOG2 are replayed (standard Windows recovery, the same as at next logon) and the hive sequence number/hash changes (issue #4977, disclosed in README); a forensic plugin would prefer RegLoadAppKeyW on a copy
summary: deferred: forensic-neutral read (copy + RegLoadAppKeyW) as execution_artifacts does. Unhappy-path derived I2 (speculative); adjudicated to I8: replay at load is the OS's own recovery with no data destroyed or wrong, and the mutation side effect is the disclosed #4977 caveat (README :20); a half-applied replay under disk-full remains unverified

trigger: the live-hive check misses because the hive is not loaded yet and the user logs on during the offline window
classification_rationale: a user signs in while the agent holds the exclusive offline mount of their not-yet-loaded hive (guard syscalls through the walk, ~15 s + overrun)
summary: deferred: documented residual; shortening the hold is the shared-seam work (timed lock, copy-based read)
